unsupported_findings.detail: Capture and export key values are created only for permission controls and are redacted from bundles and evidence.
Vector field sentinel is preserved as unsupported provider metadata only.
Reference field sentinel is preserved as unsupported provider metadata only.
Analytics APIs are not part of the source capture contract.
A green capture requires explicit write-freeze attestation; counts and timestamps are diagnostics only.

warning_findings.detail: Provider schema is captured exactly; target mapping is a later policy decision.
Alias target is captured without assuming target-side alias lifecycle.
Global synonym set identity and linked collection membership must be preserved.
Global curation set identity and linked collection membership must be preserved.
Document export is parsed as JSON values and may omit a terminal newline.
